diagnostics.finding: The guide initially used worker console.log, which is not the isolated API output channel. The actual browser regression caught missing returned logs. The example now uses the existing documented print function; no new host service or privilege was added.

A zero rational denominator is interpreted as a finite native value by LibRaw, so the explicit unknown fixture uses zero declarations and the separate nonfinite fixture uses IEEE float fields. Direct native-wire NaN injection must reject and permit clean retry.
The browser-side project import uses a variable module URL to preserve normal TypeScript module resolution; no runtime fixture or product path was weakened.

coverageLimits: Native synthetic fixtures and independent exact pixels are functional conformance evidence, not quality across physical cameras.

Recorded EXIF/makernote values are declarations, not verified measurements, calibrated sensor geometry or an automatic profile choice. Complete retained originals still include all their original metadata. Accepted working pixels remain sRGB8.
50 MP acceptance does not establish peak RSS, sustained 60fps or a physical-device/browser compatibility matrix.
No paid provider call, cloud upload, new isolated file privilege, browser/REST synchronization or arbitrary original MP/file-size cap is introduced.
The original full implementation-roadmap objective remains active.
